nonvacuity: Compiled scratch/Nonvacuity.lean with /home/ubuntu/sap/tools/sap-lean (exit 0), importing only SAP.P038.Defs. Take R=2 and r(w)=3 when w=-14 or w=7, otherwise r(w)=1. All r(w) are positive; tailWeeks at 25 is exactly {-14,7}, tailCount at 25 is 2, and tailWeeks at 12 is exactly {7}. Thus all data-dependent antecedents hold simultaneously. The same file independently evaluates empiricalP at 12 and 25 to 1/24 and 1/25 and electionDayAdjustedP to 2/25 and 1/17. It also constructs admissible k=2, k=3 and m=12,n=25 witnesses. This is an abstract instance of the canonical universally quantified claim, not a reconstruction of unavailable empirical data.
